40400.commentary: (VIN 2.5.9.10) kaṇḍuppaṭicchādi nāma yassa adhonābhi ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ kaṇḍu vā pīḷakā vā assāvo vā thullakacchu vā ābādho, tassa paṭicchādan'atthāya.

examples.text: kaṇḍuppaṭicchādiṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso catasso vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ dve vidatthiyo. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

40403.commentary: (DNa) chaddisāpaṭicchādī'ti cha disā paṭicchādento. (DNa) chaddisāpaṭicchādī'ti yathā chahi disāhi āgamanabhayaṃ na āgacchati, khemaṃ hoti nibbhayaṃ evaṃ viharanto chaddisāpaṭicchādī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpak'āpagato chaddisāpaṭicchādī ubholokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti.

40404.meaning1: should be covered; should be concealed; should be hidden (with)

examples.text: na sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādetabbaṃ bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya.

idha, bhikkhave, gopālako na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti

40406.meaning1: who restrains oneself; who guards the senses
40406.commentary: (ANa) na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hotī'ti cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hotī'ti-ādinā nayena sabb'ārammaṇesu nimittaṃ gaṇhanto yathā so gopālako vaṇaṃ na paṭicchādeti, evaṃ saṃvaraṃ na sampādeti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti

40407.synonym: apanidheti, āvuṇāti, chādeti, niguhati, pariguhati, parigūhati, pidahati
40407.commentary: (VINa) yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādetī'ti yattakāni ahāni jānanto paṭicchādeti, ahaṃ itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno'ti sabrahmacārīnaṃ n'āroceti.

examples.text: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvat'īhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

40408.meaning1: having covered; having concealed; having hidden
40408.commentary: (VINa) paṭicchādetvā dentī'ti m'āghātasamay'ādīsu paṭicchannaṃ byañjanaṃ katvā denti. viññattiyaṃ vattabbaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, sāmikā paṭicchādetvā denti, na bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetabbaṃ nābhimaṇḍalaṃ jāṇumaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambento nivāseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubb'eva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato setā kimī kaṇhasīsā pādehi ussakkitvā yāva jāṇumaṇḍalā paṭicchādesuṃ.
na kappayanti na purekkharonti, dhammā'pi tesaṃ na paṭicchitāse, na brāhmaṇo sīlavatena neyyo, pāraṅ'gato na pacceti tādī'ti.

40416.meaning2: who rears, brings up, nurses, or fosters

40417.meaning1: looks after; takes care (of); watches over
40417.meaning2: watches over, looks after, tends, nourishes to repair

examples.text: attānañ'ce piyaṃ jaññā, rakkheyya naṃ surakkhitaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ aññataraṃ yāmaṃ, paṭijaggeyya paṇḍito.
amma mā evaṃ vadetha ahaṃ yāvajīvaṃ tumhe paṭijaggissāmī'ti

40418.meaning2: nurses; treats; cares for the sick

40419.meaning1: attending to the need; taking care (of); looking after

40423.meaning2: looking after; taking care (of); watching over

40424.meaning1: looking after; taking care (of); watching over

40426.meaning2: having caused to look after; having made take care of
40426.meaningLit: having caused to personally look after

40427.meaning1: looked after; took care (of); watched over
40427.meaning2: watched over, looked after, tended, nourished to repair

examples.text: tatr'idaṃ vatthu, eko kira naṭako suvapotakaṃ gahetvā sikkhāpento vicarati. so bhikkhun'upassayaṃ upanissāya vasitvā gamanakāle suvapotakaṃ pamussitvā gato. taṃ sāmaṇeriyo gahetvā paṭijaggiṃsu.

40429.meaning2: to look after; to take care of

40430.meaning1: having looked after; having taken care (of)
40430.meaning2: having watched over, having looked after, having tended, having nourished to repair

40431.meaning2: watching over, looking after, tending, nourishing to repair

40432.meaning2: fit to be nursed or repaired

40433.meaning2: being looked after; being nursed; being tended to

40434.meaning1: keeps vigil; stays awake all night; (comm) observes the intermediate observance days

examples.text: appakā kho, mārisā, manussā manussesu matteyyā petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyino uposathaṃ upavasanti paṭijāgaronti puññāni karontī'ti.

40435.commentary: (MNa) sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato'ti ahaṃ sammāsambuddho, sabbe dhammā mayā abhisambuddhā'ti evaṃ paṭijānato tava.

examples.text: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā'ti.

nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅgh'ādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayaṃ dhammo aniyato.
dissanti, bhikkhave, sattā kāyikena rogena ekam'pi vassaṃ ārogyaṃ paṭijānamānā
santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sabb'upādānapariññāvādā paṭijānamānā. te na sammā sabb'upādānapariññaṃ paññapenti, kām'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na diṭṭh'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti

n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
samaṇā samaṇā'ti vo, bhikkhave, jano sañjānāti. tumhe ca pana, ke tumhe'ti puṭṭhā samānā, samaṇ'āmhā'ti paṭijānātha.
yuvā'si tvaṃ pabbajito, tiṭṭhāhi mama sāsane, bhuñja mānusake kāme, ahaṃ vittaṃ dadāmi te, saccaṃ te paṭijānāmi, aggiṃ vā te harām'ahaṃ.

40441.meaning1: makes the claim (of); claims (to be); supposes ones is

examples.text: yo hi, gahapati, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttam'pi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya, kim'aññatra bālyā?
kassako paṭijānāsi, na ca passāma te kasiṃ, kasiṃ no pucchito brūhi, yathā jānemu te kasiṃ.

40443.grammar: abs of caus of pati √ñā, caus, trans (+acc)
40443.meaning1: having made agree; having caused to confirm

examples.text: te upakaṭṭhāya vass'ūpanāyikāya pañcasatatāpase himavantato āgantvā nagare bhikkhāya carante disvā pasīditvā nisīdāpetvā bhojetvā paṭiññaṃ gahetvā cattāro māse attano santike vasāpetvā puna vassāratte āgaman'atthāya paṭijānāpetvā uyyojesuṃ.
asammāsambuddhā'va pana te, pāpima, samānā sammāsambuddh'āmhā'ti paṭijāniṃsu. ahaṃ kho pana, pāpima, sammāsambuddho'va samāno sammāsambuddho'mhī'ti paṭijānāmi.
mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.

40447.meaning1: should be acknowledged; should be admitted; should be confirmed
40447.meaning2: should be acknowledged; should be admitted; should be confirmed

examples.text: mamaṃ vā, bhikkhave, pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi bhūtaṃ bhūtato paṭijānitabbaṃ, iti'p'etaṃ bhūtaṃ, iti'p'etaṃ tacchaṃ, atthi c'etaṃ amhesu, saṃvijjati ca pan'etaṃ amhesū'ti.

40448.meaning1: having acknowledged; having agreed; having consented; having admitted
40448.meaning2: having acknowledged, having promised, having consented
40448.commentary: (VINa) paṭijānitvā avajānātī'ti kismiñci'd'eva vacane ānisaṃsaṃ sallakkhento ayaṃ mama vādo'ti paṭijānitvā puna kathento kathento tattha dosaṃ sallakkhetvā n'āyaṃ mama vādo'ti avajānāti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena upavāḷo bhikkhu saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno avajānitvā paṭijānāti, paṭijānitvā avajānāti, aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, sampajānamusā bhāsati.

40449.meaning1: pretending to be; claiming to be

examples.text: sādhu khv'assa, bhikkhave, yaṃ idh'ekacco sakyaputtiyapaṭiñño evarūpam'pi attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.
idha ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto, antopūtibhāvo'ti.

40450.commentary: (SNa) samaṇapaṭiñño'ti salākaggahaṇ'ādīsu kittakā vihāre samaṇā'ti gaṇanāya āraddhāya aham'pi samaṇo, aham'pi samaṇo'ti paṭiññaṃ deti, salākaggahaṇ'ādīni karoti. brahmacāripaṭiñño'ti uposathapavāraṇ'ādīsu aham'pi brahmacārī'ti paṭiññāya tāni kammāni pavisati.

examples.text: ṭhito ahaṃ, aṅgulimāla, tvañ'ca tiṭṭhā'ti. atha kho corassa aṅgulimālassa etadahosi, ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā saccavādino saccapaṭiññā. atha pan'āyaṃ samaṇo gacchaṃ y'ev'āha, ṭhito ahaṃ, aṅgulimāla, tvañ'ca tiṭṭhā'ti.

40451.meaning1: having made a promise; having vowed

40452.commentary: (VINa) paṭiññāyā'ti attano paṭijānanena paṭiññāya'pi hi ekacco, bhikkhū'ti paññāyati. tassa, ko etthā'ti? ahaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhū'ti

examples.text: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma. evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.

bhikkhū'ti bhikkhako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaṭadharo'ti bhikkhu, samaññāya bhikkhu, paṭiññāya bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhū'ti bhikkhu, tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampanno'ti bhikkhu
uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.
samanuggāhīyamāno'ti yaṃ vatthu paṭiññātaṃ hoti tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ samanuggāhīyamāno, kin'te adhigataṃ, kin'ti te adhigataṃ, kadā te adhigataṃ, kattha te adhigataṃ

40459.commentary: (MNa) anuññātapaṭiññātā'ti sikkhitā tumhe'ti evaṃ ācariyehi anuññātā, āma ācariya sikkhit'amhā'ti evaṃ sayañ'ca paṭiññātā.

examples.text: anuññātapaṭiññātā, tevijjā mayam'asm'ubho, ahaṃ pokkharasātissa, tārukkhassāyaṃ māṇavo.

40460.commentary: (DNa) yā pan'ettha ahaṃ, bhante, itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno'ti ca āma, passāmī'ti ca paṭiññā, tāya paṭiññāya āyatiṃ saṃvareyyāsī'ti karaṇaṃ, taṃ paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ nāma.

examples.text: kathañ'c'ānanda, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ hoti? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu codito vā acodito vā āpattiṃ sarati, vivarati uttānīkaroti.
m'āvoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.

40468.meaning2: having shown oneself, having appeared again

examples.text: gandhabb'āsura-yakkha-rakkhasebhi, surehi na hi bhavati suppadhaṃsiyo, tath'atto yadi bhavati tathāvidho, idha disā ca paṭidisā ca vidisā cā'ti.
yo ñātīnaṃ sakhīnaṃ vā, dāresu paṭidissati, sāhasā sampiyena vā, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

40477.meaning1: should be acknowledged; should be confessed
40477.meaningLit: to cause to be pointed out

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhāya hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
ekassa'pi ce bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ, apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī'ti, paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi
paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā, gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī'ti.

40481.meaning1: runs back to; looks back to

examples.text: api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā pubb'antaṃ vā paṭidhāveyyātha, ahesumha nu kho mayaṃ atītam'addhānaṃ, nanu kho ahesumha atītam'addhānaṃ, kiṃ nu kho ahesumha atītam'addhānaṃ

40484.meaning2: having run back to; having run near

40488.meaning1: welcomed; gladly accepted; received with pleasure
40488.commentary: (THa) paṭinanditā'ti paṭimukhabhāvena nanditā piyāyitā sampati āyatiñ'ca suṇantehi sampaṭicchitā. (SNPa) paṭinanditā'ti haṭṭhena hadayena paṭimukhaṃ gantvā nanditā sampiyāyitā.

examples.text: piyavācam'eva bhāseyya, yā vācā paṭinanditā, yaṃ anādāya pāpāni, paresaṃ bhāsate piyaṃ.
yesaṃ sambodhi'y'aṅgesu, sammā cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ, ādānapaṭinissagge, anupādāya ye ratā, khīṇ'āsavā jutimanto, te loke parinibbutā.
etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabba-upadhi-paṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti

40495.meaning1: giving up one's idea; abandoning one's opinion (if it's wrong)
40495.commentary: (ANa) appaṭinissaggamantino'ti yesaṃ hi evaṃ hoti, sace amhehi gahitaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ dhammikaṃ bhavissati, gaṇhissāma. sace adhammikaṃ, vissajjessāmā'ti, te paṭinissaggamantino nāma honti. ime pana na tathā mantentī'ti appaṭinissaggamantino.

examples.text: te taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitvā aññam'aññaṃ saññāpenti c'eva saññattiñ'ca upagacchanti, nijjhāpenti c'eva nijjhattiñ'ca upagacchanti. te saññattibalā nijjhattibalā paṭinissaggamantino, na tam'eva adhikaraṇaṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharanti, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dhammavādinī parisā.

40496.meaning1: observing letting go; watching relinquishment; contemplating giving up
40496.commentary: (SNa) paṭinissagg'ānupassī'ti paṭinissaggaṃ anupassanto. (ANa) paṭinissagg'ānupassī'ti ettha paṭinissaggo vuccati vossaggo. so ca pariccāgavossaggo pakkhandanavossaggo'ti duvidho hoti.

examples.text: paṭinissagg'ānupassī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, paṭinissagg'ānupassī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
so kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya anicc'ānupassī viharati, vay'ānupassī viharati, virāg'ānupassī viharati, nirodh'ānupassī viharati, paṭinissagg'ānupassī viharati.

att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā nigaṇṭhā'ti.
etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ ārambhapaccayā, sabb'ārambhaṃ paṭinissajja, anārambhe vimuttino.
saccā avokkama muni, thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo, sabbaṃ so paṭinissajja, sa ve santo'ti vuccati.

40499.synonym: ujjahati, cajati, jahati, jahāti, pajahāti, pariccajati, vippajahati, virājayati, vissajjeti

examples.text: yāvatatiyañ'ce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅgh'ādiseso.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sace so puriso taṃ ādittaṃ tiṇ'ukkaṃ na khippam'eva paṭinissajjeyya tassa sā ādittā tiṇ'ukkā hatthaṃ vā daheyya bāhuṃ vā daheyya aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ daheyya
